description: Stayed on the chest until the oiled cloth was on.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Took the three boys and kept Nick's night silent.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Took the stern, named six oars and the first of the flood, and cast off with three stories.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Gave the paper the dry room and left any hanging to the inn.
name: George Bryan

description: Named the three for the bed and the place of the baskets, and felt the cloth dry.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept Sam in the boys' place and noted that Nick was not singing.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked about ice, and asked where a boy stands in the boat.
name: Sam Latchet

description: In the boat, and not in the talk.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked for a dry board and left the scarlet alone.
name: Will Kemp

description: Spoke the cloak once and stopped.
name: William Shakespeare
